{{Quote|Those rodders? Thieves and killers, everyone of them! I'll die before I see them take an inch of Dimok land!|The crone, referring to the Ripoblus|<ref name="TEGTW" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] '''crone''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuthard]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sepan Civil War]] between the Dimoks and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]]. The crone expressed her feelings toward the war during an interview in her half-bombed [[Unidentified Kuthard village|village]] by a group of [[Coruscant News Network]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]], a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Unidentified Tynnan diplomat|diplomat]], and the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]'s [[Gar Stazi]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All my life I've seen war. It is too late for my children. But I would do anything for my grandchildren to live in a world of peace.|The crone, during the interview|<ref name="TEGTW" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] lived in a [[Unidentified Kuthard village|village]] on the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuthard]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sepan Civil War]], a [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]]-long conflict between the Dimoks and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]], two [[Subspecies/Legends|races]] of the [[Sepan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] both native to that [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The Dimok had lived with war her entire life, losing her children to the war. By the time a group of [[Coruscant News Network]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] found her in the then&ndash;bombed-out village, she had become an old crone. The journalists interviewed her with a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]], and she expressed her desire to see her grandchildren live in a world free of war.<ref name="TEGTW" />

After the journalists left, a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Unidentified Tynnan diplomat|diplomat]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]'s [[Gar Stazi]], who had accompanied the journalists, stayed behind, and the Tynnan began to question the crone on matters regarding her family. When asked by the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] whether she would give a small parcel of her family's land to settle a claim with the Ripoblus, the crone spat and answered that she would rather [[Death/Legends|die]]. Stazi later reflected in a letter to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Leader]] [[Jhoram Bey]] in [[137 ABY]] that the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] he met the crone was the last day he believed in peace, and that everyone, even the Dimok crone, was bred to compete.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Personality and traits==
Due to living with war her whole life and losing her children to it, the crone said she would do anything to let her grandchildren live in a world at peace. However, when asked by the Tynnan if she would give a parcel of her family's land to settle a claim, she replied with spit flying from her mouth that she would rather die than give land to the Ripoblus. The crone also thought that all Ripoblus were thieves and killers.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The crone was first mentioned in the ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
